# JIRA-004: Alerts, Modals, Windows and Progress Indicators

## Description

Testing of browser alerts (JavaScript), modal dialogs (bootstrap), window popups, and progress indicator widgets. Covers all modal and overlay-based user interactions.

## Pages Covered

| #   | Page Name              | URL Path                  |
| --- | ---------------------- | ------------------------- |
| 1   | Javascript Alerts      | `/javascript-alerts`      |
| 2   | Bootstrap Alerts       | `/bootstrap-alerts`       |
| 3   | Bootstrap Modals       | `/bootstrap-modals`       |
| 4   | Window Popup Modal     | `/window-popup-modal`     |
| 5   | Progress Bar Modal     | `/progress-bar-modal`     |
| 6   | Bootstrap Progress bar | `/bootstrap-progress-bar` |

## What to Handle

- JavaScript alert, confirm, and prompt dialogs
- Alert dismiss and button interaction
- Bootstrap static alerts (dismissible, different types)
- Bootstrap modal open, close, and button interactions
- Window popup (new tab/window) handling
- Modal backdrop interaction (click outside)
- Progress bars (static and animated)
- Progress states and completion detection

## Acceptance Criteria

- ✅ All 6 pages accessible
- ✅ JavaScript alerts can be triggered, read, and dismissed
- ✅ Alert buttons (OK, Cancel, Confirm) respond correctly
- ✅ Bootstrap alerts render and can be dismissed
- ✅ Modal dialogs open and close
- ✅ Modal buttons trigger expected actions
- ✅ Window popups detected and switched to
- ✅ Progress bars display and animate
- ✅ Progress completion states verified
- ✅ All tests use `setup('<page name>')` fixture
- ✅ Page objects created for modal/popup handling
- ✅ Assertions separate in dedicated files

## Out of Scope

- Window popup content validation (depends on external content)
- Browser-specific alert styling
- Accessibility of modal dialogs (ARIA labels beyond structure)
- Performance of progress animations
- Mobile-specific modal rendering

## Test Cases

_Test cases will be generated by the planner agent._

## Implementation Notes

- Create modal-handling.ts page object
- Create modal-assertions.ts for state and content assertions
- Handle browser alert dialogs via Playwright's dialog event handlers
- Test cases numbered JIRA-004.1, JIRA-004.2, etc.
- Use `page.once('dialog', ...)` or `page.on('dialog', ...)` for alert handling
